contract: Meta Trio v2 assessment contract (js/schema.js; FIRST_RESPONSE.md section 4). Assessment categories are the medicus categories in js/products.js.
ground_truth_note: Labels in this file were authored before any assessment source was run against them. The harness reads this file read-only and never mutates it. A scenario's ground_truth_label is the visible scene a reviewer would record from the described scene; alert_expected is true only when the scene warrants an EMS scene alert (person on ground, crowd gathered around a person, vehicle collision scene, blocked crew access, or person motionless). 'normal activity' never warrants an alert; 'indeterminate' never warrants an alert on its own; both warrant human review where the scene is confusable or unclear, which is recorded separately and is not scored as an alert. No label here is a diagnosis, a cause, a severity call, or a triage decision: labels describe only what is visible.
